feature.summary: Music templates and remix would offer ready starting points for a track and let a person create a variation of an existing track. Nothing exists on any app; it needs music generation and stored tracks first.

purpose.what_it_does: Would show template starting points (S50.24) and let the person vary an existing track (S50.25). Not built.
purpose.why_it_exists: Brief Should lines S50.24 and S50.25. Templates lower the blank-page problem; remix reuses prior work.
purpose.who_uses_it: Nobody yet. Intended: casual users who do not know how to describe music.
problems_solved: Iterating on a track without starting again.
use_cases: Pick a 'lo-fi study' template and adjust tempo.
Remix yesterday's track to be slower.

prerequisites: Music generation (F050-07) and a stored track (F050-10); neither exists.
journey: Not available. [proposed] 1. Open music. 2. Pick a template or an existing track. 3. Adjust. 4. Generate.

working: Nothing. No template or remix code found.
incomplete: A skill marketplace on desktop carries 'music' as a search keyword for creative skills (apps/desktop/src/stores/skillMarketplaceStore.ts:104). It is not a music template feature.
not_available: Templates and remix on all six apps and the API (brief: S50.24, S50.25 missing).

established.statement: Music templates are offered as starting points.
Remix starters let the user vary an existing track.

acceptance_criteria: A template list is shown and picking one prefills the music request.
Remix starts from a chosen existing track and produces a new track, leaving the original unchanged.
The original track remains playable and downloadable after a remix.
Templates are read from shared data so every app shows the same list.
A remix of a deleted or missing track shows a clear message.
inferred: Remix needs the source audio or its settings to be kept [inferred].
Templates are content, not code, so they should live in shared configuration [inferred from AGENTS.md section 4].
proposed: [proposed] Remix could reuse the prior prompt and settings rather than the audio, to keep cost down.

corrections.claim: Working in the code: Nothing. No template or remix code found.
corrections.what_the_code_shows: A Remix action exists, for images only. Web: apps/web/features/library/lib/library-chat-handoff.ts:70-77 (stageLibraryItemForImageRemix throws 'Only an image can be remixed.'), wired at apps/web/features/library/components/LibraryView.tsx:230. Shared UI: packages/ui/unified-chat/src/components/library/LibraryView.tsx:1833 shows Remix only when isImageItem(item). Mobile: apps/mobile/src/features/library/index.tsx:545-560 and 629-630 (image assets, Cloud mode only).
corrections.correction: No music template or music remix code exists. A Remix action does exist for saved images on web and mobile (Cloud mode only on mobile), and it is the nearest pattern to reuse. Say 'no music remix', not 'no remix code'.

corrections.claim: Execution table lists the flow 'Runs on: our servers' with 'No template or remix route found by search.'
corrections.what_the_code_shows: No music route exists, so a 'runs on' value is invented. The existing image Remix runs on the device: it reads the library file and stages the composer (library-chat-handoff.ts:75-90), and no server call is made at that step.
corrections.correction: Runs on: nothing (no flow exists). Do not name a location.

corrections.claim: Local mode: No local templates or remix exist in the code. Subscription, account and limits: none found.
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The page omits that the image Remix is hidden outside Cloud mode on mobile: it shows only when appMode === 'cloud' && asset.kind === 'image'. The 'none found' rows are right for music.
corrections.correction: Local mode: no music templates or remix. The existing image Remix on mobile is Cloud mode only, and a music remix would likely need the same gating.

corrections.claim: Model compatibility: needs a music model that accepts a source track. Provider restrictions: Unknown.
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The 'music' model type is reserved, and the desktop router accepts a 'music' category: llm_router.rs:633 and 930 map 'music' with image-gen, video-gen, tts and stt. This is a routing category only, and no music provider is wired. The page's Unknown is fair, but it should cite the reserved routing category.
corrections.correction: A 'music' model category is reserved in the model catalog and the desktop router, but no music model or provider is configured for it.

missing_facts: Image Remix exists in the Library on web (apps/web/features/library/lib/library-chat-handoff.ts:75-90; LibraryView.tsx:230), the shared UI (packages/ui/unified-chat/src/components/library/LibraryView.tsx:294,1833, image items only) and mobile (apps/mobile/src/features/library/index.tsx:545,629-630, Cloud mode and image only). It is the existing pattern a music remix would extend, and the page says no remix code exists.

Music is already in the shared contracts: the model type at packages/contracts/types/src/model-catalog.ts:239 and the artifact type at conversation.ts:89. The desktop router already routes a 'music' category (apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/core/llm/llm_router.rs:930) and the web classifier detects music intent (apps/web/lib/services/conversation-classification-service.ts:153). The page does not mention the router or classifier hooks.

The ElevenLabs connector is coming soon on desktop (connectorDefinitions.ts:870-881, comingSoon: true) but live as an api-key connector on web (apps/web/lib/connectors/catalog.ts:206). The page does not say the two apps differ.
